peak_seasons: Sharad Navaratri / Dasara (September/October), Maha Shivaratri (February/March), Annual Jogulamba Brahmotsavam (January/February), Telangana Bonalu & Shakambari Festival (July/August), Krishna & Tungabhadra Pushkaralu (Every 12 Years)
average_wait_time: Weekdays (Monday to Friday): Low crowd, 0 to 10 minutes wait time (best for relaxed visit); Weekends (Saturday & Sunday): Moderate crowd, 15 to 30 minutes wait time; Public Holidays: Moderate to High crowd, 30 to 45 minutes wait time
peak_wait_time: Festivals: Extremely High crowd, wait time surges to 2 to 4+ hours with long barricaded queue lines extending well outside the complex toward approaching roads
recommended_visiting_hours: Visit on weekdays between Tuesday and Thursday morning for a peaceful darshan experience and minimal queue lines,Tuesdays through Thursdays between 07:00 AM – 09:00 AM or 02:00 PM – 04:00 PM for minimal queue times and peaceful darshan.
crowd_management_notes: Follow queue lines, stay within designated barricades, and respect instructions of temple security guards. Security staff and guards assist frail devotees. Devasthanam parking lot handles vehicle traffic.
